column1: # from_label(label, n): SHAKE256(label) is read as a stream; point i = Point::hash_to_curve("from_uniform_bytes")(32 bytes i of the stream), i = 0..n (see hash_to_curve.tsv for the map).

# Labels nova uses (grep of src/): b"ck" in R1CS commitment_key (E::CE::setup(b"ck", max_size) -> from_label(b"ck", max_size.next_power_of_two() + 1); the FIRST point is h (blinding generator, DerandKey.h) and the remaining max_size.next_power_of_two() points are the ck generators) and b"ipa" in provider/ipa_pc.rs (E::CE::setup(b"ipa", 1) -> from_label(b"ipa", 2): h, then the single ck_s generator).
# gen <curve> <label> <n> <index> <x:y> <compressed 32B hex>   first 16 points of from_label(label, n)
# gens_sha256 <curve> <label> <n> <sha256 of n concatenated 32B compressed encodings> <sha256 of n concatenated x||y (64B)> <sha256 of bincode1 Vec<Affine> (u64 len + 32B each)>
# Pallas generators for label b"ck" are used by the primary (E1) commitment key, Vesta by the secondary (E2).
